snippet.title: Sonic Tameshi - SAGE 2025 Showcase Teaser
snippet.description:
Get ready for the race of the century!

Sonic Tameshi will return to SAGE along with several new stages and a new super special and difficult game mode called "Metal Sonic Challenge" inspired by Initial D with an awesome eurobeat track composed by our beloved Daki
